summary: Static-site conversion verified: (1) Phone number update — '866-843-8003' appears on /contact (in contact card and footer) and in the footer of all 7 pages; old placeholder '1-800-555-0102' does NOT appear anywhere in source or rendered pages. (2) ROI calculator now runs fully in-browser — defaults (12 reps, $8,500 deal, 8 deals/rep, 28% close) produce non-zero annual lift of $603,187; increasing reps 12->32 raises lift to $1,608,499; zero backend network calls to /api/roi (or /api/leads, /api/newsletter) during entire session. (3) All 7 routes (/, /programs, /industries, /case-studies, /resources, /about, /contact) load with meaningful content and zero console errors. (4) Contact form (data-testid contact-form) renders all required fields (contact-name, contact-email, contact-company, contact-submit); submitting empty form triggers Sonner toast 'Name, email, and company are required.' — client-side validation confirmed. Web3Forms placeholder key NOT tested with real submission (per instructions).

issues: Cookie consent banner overlays the Calendly widget on first load — cosmetic only; user can dismiss. Not blocking.

action_items: Replace Web3Forms placeholder access key ('YOUR_WEB3FORMS_ACCESS_KEY') in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js (or via REACT_APP_WEB3FORMS_KEY env var) before shipping to Pair/BlueHost, otherwise contact + newsletter submissions will fail at the Web3Forms API.
critical_code_review_comments: lib/api.js correctly reads key from process.env.REACT_APP_WEB3FORMS_KEY with a placeholder fallback — good pattern for static hosting.

ROICalculator.jsx: computeROI() is pure and memoized via useMemo dependency [reps,avgDeal,dealsPerRep,closeRate] (uplift is constant 22, correctly omitted). Math verified against expected annual ~$603K.

Backend server.py and /app/backend/tests are still present but no longer exercised by the frontend. If the site is intended to be fully static going forward, the backend directory could be removed or excluded from the deploy artifact for Pair/BlueHost — otherwise it is dead code from the frontend's perspective (no functional impact).
Contact.jsx still loads Calendly widget.js and embeds the inline widget — works, unrelated to backend removal.
Footer.jsx line 109 and Contact.jsx line 190 are the ONLY two source occurrences of the phone number; consider extracting to a single constant (e.g., in data/content.js) to avoid future drift.
seed_data_creation: None. No form submissions were made (Web3Forms key is placeholder — instructions said not to submit).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static conversion is complete and working. ROI calc is client-side (useMemo of computeROI). Forms POST to https://api.web3forms.com/submit via submitLead/subscribeNewsletter in src/lib/api.js. The access_key is a placeholder — real submission will 400 from Web3Forms until REACT_APP_WEB3FORMS_KEY is set. All data-testids from iteration_1 remain valid: page-contact, contact-form, contact-name, contact-email, contact-company, contact-submit, contact-success, roi-calculator, roi-annual, roi-reps/-avg-deal/-deals-per-rep/-close-rate (Radix sliders → use [role='slider'] + keyboard arrows), site-footer, calendly-embed.
